title: Delivery (Hillevi)
description: Hillevi Cruel-Sea asks the player to deliver a bottle of Nightshade Extract to Wuunferth the Unliving at the Palace of the Kings in Windhelm.

base_facts: I sell produce at my market stall in Windhelm's Stone Quarter.
My family owns Hollyfrost Farm outside the city.
Wuunferth the Unliving pays us for every portion of Nightshade we plant.
I have a bottle of Nightshade Extract that needs delivering to Wuunferth.

HILLEVI_EXPLAINS: I asked someone to deliver the Nightshade Extract to Wuunferth for me.
QUEST_STARTED: My delivery request has been accepted.

base_facts: I am the court wizard in Windhelm, residing in the Palace of the Kings.
I pay the Cruel-Sea family for Nightshade they grow at Hollyfrost Farm.
Nightshade Extract is very poisonous but has its uses.

DELIVER_COMPLETE: The Nightshade Extract has been delivered to me.
Player delivers Nightshade Extract to Wuunferth, quest completes at .

When asked whether she grows the crops all by herself she will mention that her family owns Hollyfrost Farm outside the city, and, on top of that, also receive payment from Wuunferth the Unliving for every portion of.
Hand over the extract and he will thank you with a leveled amount of gold.

beats.comment: Player learns Hillevi needs someone to deliver Nightshade Extract to Wuunferth.
Player accepts the delivery task, quest stage 10 set.
Player delivers Nightshade Extract to Wuunferth, quest completes at stage 200.
